title: Must-Watch Animated Films
intro: Animation is not a genre, it is a feeling. These six films will shake you, haunt you and leave you staring at the ceiling.

films.title: Paprika
films.line: Dreams bleed into reality until no one can tell the difference anymore.

films.title: Akira
films.line: A city on the edge of collapse and one boy holding terrifying power inside him.

films.title: Wolfwalkers
films.line: Two girls from opposite worlds discover a secret that could unravel everything they were taught to believe.

films.title: Perfect Blue
films.line: Fame fractures a young woman's sense of self in the most unsettling way imaginable.

films.title: The Tale of Princess Kaguya
films.line: A life of breathtaking beauty unfolds with a sorrow that will stay with you for days.

films.title: Anomalisa
films.line: Loneliness has never felt this eerily alive or this quietly devastating.

films.title: Persepolis
films.line: A girl's defiant voice carries the weight of a country tearing itself apart.

films.title: Waltz with Bashir
films.line: Memory becomes a ghost story when a soldier tries to recover what war erased.

films.title: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
films.line: A life fully lived still aches when it belongs to someone who was never free.

films.title: Watership Down
films.line: A haunting rabbit odyssey that carries far more dread than any childhood film should.
